consequence.statement: HelmRepository objects validated against the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected.
consequence.remediation: Verify HelmRepository objects applied against the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema include status.artifact.digest; objects written with a status.artifact must carry the digest field.

assertion.statement: The computed artifact diff between the flux v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles shows that status.artifact.digest became a required field in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of helmrepositories.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, and objects that omit it are rejected.
